intro.title: Lord Shiva Idols
intro.descriptionHtml: Exquisite range of Lord Shiva idols handcrafted in natural gemstones. Made in Gomed, Jade, Tiger eye, crystal and other gemstone, all our gemstones are 100% natural and unheated. Gemstone idols are considered to be highly auspicious and believed to resonate high divine vibes. Shiva is worshipped for blessings of harmony, peace, spiritual progress and good health. Available are Natraj, Shiva Parivar, meditation and other idols of Shiva which are bound to make aesthetic divine decor.
